This composition looks like an 18Ni maraging steel, closest to grade 300 (Ni 18, Mo 5, Co 9, Ti 0.7). This alloy has no cobalt and less Mo, but a high Ti content of 2.5%. That much Ti would form Ni3Ti precipitates and give strong age hardening. Without Co, strength is somewhat lower. Binary Fe-Ni-Ti maraging steels with 2.5% Ti reach about 1700–2000 MPa. This is an estimate from recalled alloy data, not a calculation or a lookup.
